en: Added `<server>.<key>=<value>` to `claude plugin install --config`, so a bundled `.mcpb` MCP server's own settings can be set at install time and it starts without visiting `/plugin` → Configure
zh: 为 `claude plugin install --config` 新增 `<server>.<key>=<value>`，使随附的 `.mcpb` MCP server 自身设置可在安装时配置，无需进入 `/plugin` → Configure 即可启动
